existing_e19f_B_monitor_resistor_term.basis: Vmax/Rmin, zero-drop bound, Rmin=.975R (1% initial +100ppm/K*150K); normal other-node potentials within0..source. No assumed LED VF or logicVOL reduces this bound.

KCL_at_e19f_plane: I_e19f_F_to_plane = I_e19f_into_plane_sheet + I_e19f_plane_to_B; include C11081 and R9029 at the B branch and all actual F-plane injections.
shared_current_and_voltage: The source e19f F-to-plane resistance multiplies its actual combined sheet-plus-B current; the separate e19f plane-to-B resistance multiplies only its B branch current. Target F/B currents follow their actual loads. A future network must not use the same full 0.36A in all four segments.
